morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics faces export revenue contraction despite freight relief and cheaper propane fuel.
what_changed: Tile export projections have dropped significantly to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Units are shifting away from PNG to propane as supply conditions improve.
Ocean container freight rates for exports dropped by up to 50 percent.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports projected to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Container freight rates fell up to 50% for ceramic exports [d6c30857de2c]
Improved propane availability allows units to reduce higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Impact of Somany Ceramics' planned 5 MSM debottlenecking on local Morbi manufacturing or OEM contracts [0f642d309dd8]
Competitive dynamics and revenue targets of new/expanding entrants like Apollo Pipes targeting Rs 1,000 crore in ceramics [a31fabfc72dc]
Export order volume trends following container freight rate reductions [d6c30857de2c]

surat.headline: Surat cluster sees positive investment and order demand amid tightening payment and compliance norms.
what_changed: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore investment.
Crude oil prices dropped 17% in 10 days, lowering raw material input costs for MMF textiles.
Position Printing Association implemented a 15% rate hike and mandated a strict 45-day payment window.
Surat diamond units halved Diwali breaks to accommodate improved order inflows.
stress_signals: Textile printing charges raised by 15% with a strict 45-day payment window post-Diwali, potentially straining working capital [ad48975ddfcf]
improvement_signals: Clearance of 627 units under Surat Textile Policy driving Rs 1,521 crore investment [021c037e28d9]
Crude oil price drop of 17% offering input cost relief to MMF textile units [71350aa24679]
Diamond processing units halving festive breaks due to stronger order demand [5fc0b7b85616]
what_to_watch: Working capital cycles of textile trading and printing units adhering to the mandatory 45-day payment terms.
Implementation timeline and compliance requirements of the Ministry of Textiles' fabric capacity database drive [5177389da7be].
Adherence of market traders to Fire Department safety plans during the festive period [f5b4f3ab1ebd].
